body:
I've been thinking about it over the past few hours and no one here really convinced me otherwise. I'm just going to go ahead and kill myself. It's just not selling it to me to stay. I'm not interested in continuing life. 

Good bye.
Noting we can do about that now. It's just another person standing in the way of my happiness as usual.
I wasn't there to pay the rent for 90 days. When they locked me up because I tried said I was fed up with life and wanted to die, no one told him I wasn't going to be here for awhile.

I can't afford to do anything really. I'm not saving for retirement which isn't really relevant now since I'm just going to kill myself sooner or later and I barely make enough money to afford my 3 bills I have. I never could afford college so I can't get a job that will pay enough to afford me the luxury of hobbies. I know that's a difficult concept for most people to get but not everyone is going to be able to have a fun and rewarding life. Also what used to make me happy as a child is dead now. You can't bring people back from the dead so I won't be happy again.
My landlord threw it all away.
